coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); tick squares from ink at 400 dpi; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: The investor completes the information and ownership pages, initials one eligibility line and signs on the last page (the name may be typed); a joint owner signs below; a custodian completes its own section for custodial accounts; the company accepts on the last page.

sure_per_page.1: sure of the places; the boxes of the 27 caption-only cells are the empty room after each caption (nothing printed); the circular date is likely the issuer's
sure_per_page.2: sure (one judgement: the State / Zip Code rule is split in two)
sure_per_page.6: sure (judgement: each date made of several underscore runs is one place; its parts are listed)

1: the underscore in the filing header line ("chosen_ex4.htm", y 35): part of a file name
the heavy rules above and below the three block captions (Individual, Joint-Owner, Corporation): caption frames
2: the heavy rules above and below the section captions (Non-Custodial Ownership, Custodial Ownership, Custodian Information)
the captions above the custodian rules
4: the underline of the run-in heading "Operating Agreement" (y 294)
6: the printed words "PLEASE TYPE YOUR NAME TO SIGN" and "SUBSCRIPTION ACCEPTED", the company name and description
